incident.description: Pre-Collector-labeled forecast, Monte Carlo, ranking, and purchase-readiness stages were bound to the Collector v1 August 1 current foundation instead of the owner-approved pre-Collector target universe and reconciliation authority.

quarantined_commit_range.treatment: Preserve for audit. No output produced by this range may be treated as authoritative pre-Collector analysis until individually rebound and recertified.

lane_boundary_policy.required_target_universe_authority: certified pre-Collector candidate or reconciled universe approved by the owner

mandatory_fail_closed_controls: Reject a pre-Collector stage when any target authority path contains collector_v1 or secret_lair.
Reject a pre-Collector stage when target product IDs are not members of the approved pre-Collector universe authority.
Reject a pre-Collector stage when Collector products appear as target rows instead of explicitly typed comparable rows.
Reject a stage when the target universe count or identity hash changes without an owner-approved versioned decision.
Reject downstream inheritance when the prior package does not declare and prove the same governed target lane.
Reject forecasting until the universe reconciliation stage reaches its owner-review checkpoint.
Reject ranking and purchase analysis until corrected pre-Collector forecasts are certified.
recovery_sequence: Inventory and classify all pre-Collector governance, universe, reconciliation, comparable, model, forecast, ranking, and package artifacts.
Identify the last authentic pre-Collector certified control point before the wrong target binding.
Certify the approved pre-Collector target universe identity and count.
Certify selected Collector comparables as reference evidence only.
Assess each quarantined architecture component for reusable code versus invalid output.
Rebind reusable components to the correct pre-Collector authorities.
Rerun only the stages required after the authentic control point.
Finalize the pre-Collector lane before beginning Secret Lair finalization or combined MTG integration.
change_control: No target-lane, target-authority, universe identity, product count, comparable-role, or authorization change may occur without an explicit owner-approved versioned decision and recertification.
